measurement: same process monotonic domain; exact account/domain/attempt join
receipt_boundary: WS message ready before JSON decode; excludes NIC/kernel/TLS/WS assembly
first_write_boundary: application plaintext accepted by local transport; excludes TCP ACK

bursts.boundary: Exact receipt domain/session/sequence groups across strategy instances. Prep interval includes preflight/sign/body work. Wall interval overlap is association, not CPU-time proof; scheduler sampling is separate.

cold_connect.boundary: Only >=100us cold future polls are logged; these quantiles are thresholded tails, not all handshakes. CPU time excludes off-CPU preemption. These polls have no order identity and are not causally joined to nearby orders.

warm_primary_started_during_observed_col.boundary: HTTP helper start lies inside a thresholded background cold-poll wall interval, by same-host wall timestamps. Temporal association, not a causal join or exact queue-interval overlap.

limits: Different live windows are not controlled A/B.
Complete attempts whose origin and completion are both within the steady window; in-flight boundary attempts are censored.
Callbacks without a market receipt have no fabricated market origin.
Minute histogram summaries are not pooled event percentiles.
Cold poll diagnostics are thresholded at 100us and have no exact order identity.
Local plaintext transport write is not TCP or exchange acknowledgement.
